candidate.en: The feast of the village's patron saint is celebrated at the Sveti Martin church in Kampus.
Walking through the hamlets is a walk from Prvo Selo through Brdo, Kampus and Postrana that takes about an hour and passes churches, old houses and vineyard views at every turn.
Kocje rock formations is a short walk from Brdo through an unusual dolomite limestone landscape.
State Archive is for anyone researching Korčula Island history, the archive in the former school building in Kampus holds historical documents from across the island and Lastovo.
Winemaking is local families still produce wine in Žrnovo in the traditional way.
Walking and hiking is the village is well positioned for walks towards the Defora southern coast and up to the higher ground around Brdo.
